channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Better Fruit Press
item.description: Makes the fruit press quicker and allows squeezing over barrels.

item.title: Solaria's Solace Server Tweaks
item.description: A bunch of fixes and additions for the server.

item.title: Superflat Survival Challenge
item.description: How long can you survive in a completely flat world with no ores, plants or food?

item.title: VS Discord Relay
item.description: A simple discord to server chat bridge for your Vintage Story server needs!

item.title: C&N Jewelry
item.description: Rough/cut gems/jewelry and encrusting in the armor/tools with buffs

item.title: Upgraded Berry Bush
item.description: Takes your stinky, OP legacy berry bushes and turns them into shiny new ones.

item.title: Fieldwright
item.description: Client-side blueprint preview and build-along tool with ghost and live material checklist.

item.title: Dense Ground Storage
item.description: Place down more items per block and on chiseled blocks

item.title: Batch Production Molds
item.description: Adds realistic "Vanilla+" style batch production molds to produce multiple work pieces at once.

item.title: Global Illuminator
item.description: An early version of global illumination and skylighting designed to work with Sheydermod

item.title: The Ultimate Mod Manager
item.description: An in-game mod manager that's suitable even for remote servers without terminal/FTP access.

item.title: The Nether – A Hellish Adventure
item.description: Explore a hostile new dimension filled with molten caverns, evil ores, fungi and restless spirits.

item.title: Red to Blue Clay Conversion
item.description: Simple blue clay recipe made from red clay and crushed quartz

item.title: Quivers and Sheaths Fork
item.description: 1.22 Fork

item.title: Relics of Transmission - The Media Mod
item.description: A multimedia mod, allowing you to listen to music, watch videos/livestreams and listen to the Radio.

item.title: KCs Dragon Player!
item.description: Adds an anthropomorphic dragon player model to the game

item.title: Multiverse
item.description: A multi-dimensional framework, with crystals.

item.title: Immersive Backpacks Compat & Tweaks
item.description: A mod that adds compat for other mods to Immersive Backpacks and makes some tweaks!

item.title: Lumos
item.description: Reworking the game's lighting system and fixing related bugs

item.title: Chinese Line Break
item.description: Fix an issue with abnormal line breaks in the Chinese interface text

item.title: Locusts for all
item.description: Allows all classes to be able to use the tuning spear to tame multiple locusts and offer more tweaks

item.title: Herty Cups
item.description: Resin Tapping for Vintage Story

item.title: Brickyard: Immersive Brickmaking
item.description: Adds in-world brickmaking in an immersive and involved manner.

item.title: Pin Matrix - Waypoint Manager
item.description: Client-side bulk waypoint manager for Vintage Story

item.title: Banners Migration
item.description: Import Flags from Obsolote Banners mod to newer Heraldry Flags

item.title: Eternal Seraph: Backpacks
item.description: Yes. New backpacks again.

item.title: Messenger Pigeons
item.description: Send mail across the world using distance based messenger pigeons with secure pigeon boxes.

item.title: BetterEr Prospecting
item.description: Altered prospecting experience with focus on reducing randomness

item.title: Pirate
item.description: Just simple mod to add Pirate class, Aztec gold coins, Pirate tools.

item.title: Fullbright Toggle
item.description: Fullbright toggle so you can always see in the dark
